meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会使用 dxpy 与 dx CLI 帮你操作 DNAnexus:上传下载文件、构建和部署 app/applet、运行与监控作业、编排工作流,并处理 FASTQ/BAM/VCF 等基因数据文件。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 DNAnexus 应用开发、数据上传下载、作业运行监控等操作时触发;处理 FASTQ/BAM/VCF 等基因数据时也会触发。

say.text: 监控我最近的作业,汇总失败原因并给出修改建议。
say.note: Claude 会查询作业状态并解释日志。

howto.what_en: Claude uses dxpy and the dx CLI to help with DNAnexus: upload/download files, build and deploy apps/applets, run and monitor jobs, orchestrate workflows, and handle FASTQ/BAM/VCF genomics files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when tasks involve DNAnexus app development, data upload/download, job execution monitoring, or processing genomics files like FASTQ/BAM/VCF.

say_en.text: Write a dxpy script to upload sample.fastq and run an alignment applet.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the script and explain the steps.

say_en.text: Create a dxapp.json for a VCF applet with inputs, outputs, and dependencies.
say_en.note: Claude will output the config and highlight key fields.

say_en.text: Monitor my recent jobs and summarize failures with fixes.
say_en.note: Claude will query job status and explain logs.
